page.title: Cognitive Assessment
page.description: A structured run through several kinds of task that produces a recreational performance profile. Compare it only with your own earlier runs of the same protocol.
page.structureNote: The same games, levels and number of challenges every time, so runs of one protocol can be compared. Harder levels weigh more. Each round explains its rules; rounds do not count toward level records.

flow.unavailable: This assessment step is not available.

disclaimer.title: What this is — and is not
disclaimer.what: This is a recreational self-evaluation tool. Scores describe how you performed on these specific exercises: accuracy and pace, with harder levels weighing more. They are based on few challenges, carry a wide margin and are not compared with population norms.
disclaimer.not: It is not an IQ test, a psychometric instrument or a clinical or professional diagnosis, and it should not be used for hiring or any consequential decision.

history.title: Past results
history.description: Each run is compared only with your previous run of the same protocol.
